explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration saying that the order of `p.Gal` divides `p.natDegree !`. Nothing under `Mathlib/FieldTheory` mentions `factorial` at all. The only `card` lemmas in `PolynomialGaloisGroup.lean` are `card_of_separable` (the order equals `finrank F p.SplittingField` when `p` is separable) and `prime_degree_dvd_card`. A search for patterns joining `Gal`, `card` and `!` or `factorial` across Mathlib found nothing relevant. Mathlib does have the pieces: `galActionHom_injective`, `Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial` and `ncard_rootSet_le`. But putting them together takes the library's own helper lemma `natCard_gal_dvd_factorial_card_rootSet` plus a degree bound, which is more than one or two lines of routine glue.
